items.title: Frank Naundorf Interview, 1965-02-25
items.q: Now tell us about your wife. Your wife plays Banjo... When I was met with her... I was also interested in her

ctx.x: 1962. She was also interested in jazz, of course, had no big knowledge, and was interested in music. She was interested in music. She was interested in my collection and my knowledge. I was also interested in her, that she should change the instrument and instead of the guitar, that Benjo should be able to grab the instrument.
How long did you play Banjo?
